title: Distributed Online Submodular Maximization under Communication Delays: A Simultaneous Decision-Making Approach
abstract: arXiv:2603.27803v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We provide a distributed online algorithm for multi-agent submodular maximization under communication delays. We are motivated by the future distributed information-gathering tasks in unknown and dynamic environments, where utility functions naturally exhibit the diminishing-returns property, i.e., submodularity. Existing approaches for online submodular maximization either rely on sequential multi-hop communication, resulting in prohibitive delays and restrictive connectivity assumptions, or restrict each agent's coordination to its one-hop neighborhood only, thereby limiting the coordination performance. To address the issue, we provide the Distributed Online Greedy (DOG) algorithm, which integrates tools from adversarial bandit learning with delayed feedback to enable simultaneous decision-making across arbitrary network topologies. translated_title: 通信延迟下的分布式在线子模最大化：一种同时决策方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2603.27803v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们提供了一种在通信延迟下用于多智能体子模最大化的分布式在线算法。我们的动机源于未来在未知和动态环境中进行的分布式信息收集任务，其中效用函数自然表现出收益递减性质，即子模性。现有的在线子模最大化方法要么依赖于顺序多跳通信，导致严重的延迟和限制性的连接假设，要么将每个智能体的协调限制在其一跳邻域内，从而限制了协调性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了分布式在线贪心（DOG）算法，该算法将对抗性赌博机学习与延迟反馈工具相结合，以实现在任意网络拓扑上的同时决策。我们提供了DOG相对于最优解的近似性能，并刻画了次优性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DOG的分布式在线贪心算法，通过结合对抗性赌博机学习和延迟反馈，解决了通信延迟下多智能体子模最大化问题，实现了任意网络拓扑上的同时决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the DOG algorithm, a distributed online greedy method that integrates adversarial bandit learning with delayed feedback to address multi-agent submodular maximization under communication delays, enabling simultaneous decision-making over arbitrary network topologies.
